approval_scope: Public/descriptive nonoperational language only; no fact verification, blind label/domain review, semantic duplicate clearance, or publication approval.
human_queue_scope: Conservative holds include nonpublic/uncertain scope, restricted text, potential operational detail, and unresolved repetition. These are not assertions that every held row contains actual sensitive technical information.
existing_audits: Historical findings only, bound to input_candidate_git_blob. Cross-record repetition is not cleared by grammar changes or deleting duplicate sentences within one record.
targeted_edit_checks: Only text and derived length changed; rows outside the editorial scope retained byte-for-byte. Old rows were not removed or reordered.
reviewer: Codex assistant; not an independent human or blind label reviewer
screening_vs_reading: All 500 rows received a conservative scope decision. All 125 low-label texts were fully read; nonlow rows were held conservatively rather than represented as fully language-reviewed.
public_scope_limit: Public/descriptive scope is assessed from supplied text. Statements about publication inside synthetic examples were not verified against external sources.
